design.section: G6 SSH discovery failure: diagnosis and bounded proposal (2026-10-09)

source_changes: Pass one await_ready absolute monotonic deadline into per-machine SSH discovery; integer floor allowance in 1..5, refuse before any scan with sub-second budget, never accept late success.

Revalidate recorded launch/current run and live runner before attempts and acceptance; all endpoints must yield structurally valid SSH keyscan data before first known_hosts write; retained trust stays unchanged.
SSH-specific sole waitpid owner captures at most 16KiB per native stream and supervises/reaps only its unreaped child; cleared SSH/source override environment and closed unrelated descriptors.

Private immutable 0600 per-run/per-machine diagnostics retain base64 native streams, status/signal/attempt/elapsed/bound facts. Public errors reference location/status without raw native data. Before-scan refusal has no invented diagnostic.
Same-PID runner setsid before argument processing/machine creation/live tuple; already-own-session leader is a no-op and setsid refusal creates no machine.
Existing runtime and pinned machine suites cover synthetic readiness cases, actual confined SSH-capture children, and real runner session/control/shutdown using a test-owned machine child.
historical_cause: SSH transport endpoint cause and later runner disappearance remain unresolved; source readiness/session gaps are not a historical failure diagnosis.
operations: No Git/index/ref/lifecycle/probe/VM/package actions performed; old campaigns, predecessor K68, other repositories and private state untouched.
compatibility: No state/protocol/schema/input or cleanup authority change; strict SSH authentication and guest source/toplevel checks unchanged. Separate session does not escape cgroups or prove genuine predecessor lifetime.
protected_bytes: Only four assigned owners plus root doc differ from HEAD; all other tracked paths, including generic Software.command, State/resources/closure/machine, inputs/captures/navigation/PNGs, remain HEAD-identical.
gaps: New tests have not executed; no claimed host/guest/predecessor/cgroup proof.
Exact committed K/E hosted checks and affected independent review precede package/real verification.
Durable ordinary-host operation context and fresh capacity including both retained campaign growth budgets remain root-owned prerequisites.
packet_status: source-only frozen for root inspection; no operation wrapper
